\newcommand{\PrimaryFindingText}{All 4 primary signed-rank comparisons met the 5\% BH threshold; only 1 had a nonzero median paired difference.}
\newcommand{\PrimaryDetailedFindingText}{All four primary signed-rank comparisons remained different after BH correction. Outgoing HHI was higher for Cases (median paired difference 0.035, 95\% bootstrap CI [0.033, 0.038]; $r_{\mathrm{rb}}=0.580$). Coauthor-citation rate, reciprocity, and clustering had zero median paired differences because of ties, although their matched rank-biserial effects were positive (0.116, 0.468, 0.395).}
\newcommand{\SecondaryDetailedFindingText}{Among secondary outcomes, journal endogamy was lower for Cases (median paired difference -0.028, 95\% bootstrap CI [-0.030, -0.026]), whereas maximum annual dyadic surge share was higher (difference 0.047, 95\% CI [0.044, 0.051]).}
\newcommand{\SensitivityFindingText}{All 4 exact-$h_5$ primary comparisons retained positive rank-biserial effects; exact-$h_5$ outgoing HHI had a median paired difference of 0.034 (95\% CI [0.031, 0.037]). Under same-year coauthor classification, the median paired difference was 0.000 (95\% CI [-0.003, 0.000]).}
